license_required.quote: it shall be unlawful for any person who does not have a license, registration, permit or certificate to engage in the practice of any profession regulated by the board

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the state board of healing arts.

name.quote: "Board" means the state board of healing arts.

type.quote: The healing arts include any system, treatment, operation, diagnosis, prescription or practice for the ascertainment, cure, relief, palliation, adjustment or correction of any human disease, ailment, deformity, injury, alteration or enhancement of a condition or appearance and includes specifically, but not by way of limitation, the practice of medicine and surgery; the practice of osteopathic medicine and surgery; and the practice of chiropractic.

age_minimum.quote: No person shall receive a permanent license under this act until the person has furnished satisfactory evidence to the board that the person has attained legal age.

degree_required.value: Graduate of an accredited school of medicine or osteopathic medicine (Doctor of Medicine or Doctor of Osteopathy degree)
degree_required.quote: present proof that the applicant is a graduate of an accredited healing arts school or college

accrediting_body.value: Liaison Committee on Medical Education (LCME) for MD programs; American Osteopathic Association for DO programs
accrediting_body.quote: educational standards substantially equivalent to the minimum educational standards for medical colleges as established by the liaison committee on medical education or any successor organization

degree_level.quote: present proof that the applicant is a graduate of an accredited healing arts school or college

school_approval_basis.quote: educational standards substantially equivalent to the minimum educational standards for medical colleges as established by the liaison committee on medical education or any successor organization

credential_pegged.quote: present proof that the applicant is a graduate of an accredited healing arts school or college

required.quote: Any person seeking a license to practice medicine and surgery shall present proof that such person has completed acceptable postgraduate study as may be required by the board by regulations.

experience_source.quote: Any person seeking a license to practice medicine and surgery shall present proof that such person has completed acceptable postgraduate study as may be required by the board by regulations.

kind.quote: Any person seeking a license to practice medicine and surgery shall present proof that such person has completed acceptable postgraduate study as may be required by the board by regulations.

exams.name: United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE) or equivalent national board examination
exams.notes: Applicants must present evidence of proficiency in basic sciences issued by the national board of medical examiners or pass an examination required by the board; also must pass a clinical examination prescribed by the board.
exams.quote: Present to the board evidence of proficiency in the basic sciences issued by the national board of medical examiners, the board of examiners of osteopathic physicians and surgeons or the national board of chiropractic examiners or such other examining body as may be approved by the board or in lieu thereof pass such examination as the board may require in the basic science subjects

exams.name: Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG) examination
exams.notes: Required only for foreign medical graduates in addition to the standard examination.
exams.quote: if the applicant is a foreign medical graduate the applicant shall pass an examination given by the educational commission for foreign medical graduates.

required.quote: The board shall require every active licensee to submit evidence of satisfactory completion of a program of continuing education required by the board.

available.quote: The board, without examination, may issue a license to a person who has been in the active practice of a branch of the healing arts in some other state, territory, the District of Columbia or other country upon certificate of the proper licensing authority

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a valid license in another state/territory/country with standards at least equal to Kansas, original license based on equivalent examination, active practice since licensure, and reasonable ability to communicate in English; individual qualifications must be substantially equivalent to Kansas requirements.
requirements.quote: An applicant for a license by endorsement shall not be licensed unless, as determined by the board, the applicant's individual qualifications are substantially equivalent to the Kansas legal requirements.

exists.quote: "Board" means the state board of healing arts.

regulatory_model.quote: it shall be unlawful for any person who does not have a license, registration, permit or certificate to engage in the practice of any profession regulated by the board

credential_type.quote: Every license issued under this act shall be presumptive evidence of the right of the holder to practice that branch of the healing arts and only such branch as is specified therein.

is_mandatory.quote: it shall be unlawful for any person who does not have a license, registration, permit or certificate to engage in the practice of any profession regulated by the board

title_protection.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person who is not licensed under the Kansas healing arts act or whose license has been revoked or suspended to open or maintain an office for the practice of the healing arts as defined in this act or to announce or hold out to the public the intention, authority or skill to practice the healing arts as defined in the Kansas healing arts act by the use of any professional degree or designation, sign, card, circular, device, advertisement or representation.

scope_protection.quote: it shall be unlawful for any person who does not have a license, registration, permit or certificate to engage in the practice of any profession regulated by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or securing an original, renewal, or reinstated license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has committed fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or securing an original, renewal or reinstated license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of an act of unprofessional or dishonorable conduct or professional incompetency.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has committed an act of unprofessional or dishonorable conduct or professional incompetency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or class A misdemeanor, or substantially similar offense in another jurisdiction, whether or not related to the practice of the healing arts.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has been convicted of a felony or class A misdemeanor, or substantially similar offense in another jurisdiction, whether or not related to the practice of the healing arts

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of fraudulent or false advertisements.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has used fraudulent or false advertisements.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Addiction to or distribution of intoxicating liquors or drugs for unlawful purposes.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee is addicted to or has distributed intoxicating liquors or drugs for any other than lawful purposes.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or repeated violation of the healing arts act, pharmacy act, or uniform controlled substances act, or related rules and regulations.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has willfully or repeatedly violated this act, the pharmacy act of the state of Kansas or the uniform controlled substances act, or any rules and regulations adopted pursuant thereto

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unlawfully practicing a branch of the healing arts for which the licensee is not licensed.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has unlawfully invaded the field of practice of any branch of the healing arts in which the licensee is not licensed to practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practice under a false or assumed name, or impersonation of another practitioner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has engaged in the practice of the healing arts under a false or assumed name, or the impersonation of another practitioner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Ability to practice impaired by reason of physical or mental illness, alcohol, drugs, or controlled substances.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee's ability to practice the healing arts with reasonable skill and safety to patients is impaired by reason of physical or mental illness, or condition or use of alcohol, drugs or controlled substances.

disciplinary_grounds.description: License revoked, suspended, or limited, or other disciplinary action taken by another state, territory, or country.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has had a license to practice the healing arts revoked, suspended or limited, has been censured or has had other disciplinary action taken, or an application for a license denied, by the proper licensing authority of another state, territory, District of Columbia, or other country.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any lawful rule and regulation or order or directive previously entered by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has violated any lawful rule and regulation promulgated by the board or violated any lawful order or directive of the board previously entered by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report or reveal knowledge required to be reported under K.S.A. 65-28,122.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to report or reveal the knowledge required to be reported or revealed under K.S.A. 65-28,122, and amendments thereto.

disciplinary_grounds.description: For medicine and surgery licensees: failure to inform breast abnormality patients in writing of alternative treatment methods.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee, if licensed to practice medicine and surgery, has failed to inform in writing a patient suffering from any form of abnormality of the breast tissue for which surgery is a recommended form of treatment, of alternative methods of treatment

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cheating on or attempting to subvert the validity of the licensing examination.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has cheated on or attempted to subvert the validity of the examination for a license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Found to be mentally ill, disabled, not guilty by reason of insanity, or incompetent to stand trial by a court.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has been found to be mentally ill, disabled, not guilty by reason of insanity, not guilty because the licensee suffers from a mental disease or defect or incompetent to stand trial by a court of competent jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, selling, administering, distributing, or giving a controlled substance for other than medically accepted or lawful purposes.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has prescribed, sold, administered, distributed or given a controlled substance to any person for other than medically accepted or lawful purposes.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of a federal law or regulation relating to controlled substances.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has violated a federal law or regulation relating to controlled substances.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to furnish the board, its investigators or representatives, any information legally requested by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to furnish the board, or its investigators or representatives, any information legally requested by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Sanctions or disciplinary actions taken against the licensee by a peer review committee, healthcare facility, governmental agency, or professional association for similar conduct.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Sanctions or disciplinary actions have been taken against the licensee by a peer review committee, healthcare facility, a governmental agency or department or a professional association or society for acts or conduct similar to acts or conduct that would constitute grounds for disciplinary action under this section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report to the board any adverse action taken against the licensee by another state, licensing jurisdiction, peer review body, healthcare facility, or law enforcement.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to report to the board any adverse action taken against the licensee by another state or licensing jurisdiction, a peer review body, a healthcare facility, a professional association or society, a governmental agency, by a law enforcement agency or a court

disciplinary_grounds.description: Surrender of a license or privileges while under investigation for similar conduct.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has surrendered a license or authorization to practice the healing arts in another state or jurisdiction, has surrendered the authority to utilize controlled substances issued by any state or federal agency, has agreed to a limitation to or restriction of privileges at any medical care facility or has surrendered the licensee's membership on any professional staff or in any professional association or society while under investigation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report to the board the surrender of a license or professional staff membership while under investigation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to report to the board surrender of the licensee's license or authorization to practice the healing arts in another state or jurisdiction or surrender of the licensee's membership on any professional staff or in any professional association or society while under investigation

disciplinary_grounds.description: An adverse judgment, award, or settlement resulting from a medical liability claim related to conduct that would constitute grounds for disciplinary action.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has an adverse judgment, award or settlement against the licensee resulting from a medical liability claim related to acts or conduct similar to acts or conduct that would constitute grounds for disciplinary action under this section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report to the board any adverse judgment, settlement, or award from a medical malpractice liability claim.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to report to the board any adverse judgment, settlement or award against the licensee resulting from a medical malpractice liability claim

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain a policy of professional liability insurance as required by law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to maintain a policy of professional liability insurance as required by K.S.A. 40-3402 or 40-3403a, and amendments thereto.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to pay the premium surcharges as required by K.S.A. 40-3404.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to pay the premium surcharges as required by K.S.A. 40-3404, and amendments thereto.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly submitting misleading, deceptive, untrue, or fraudulent representation on a claim form, bill, or statement.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has knowingly submitted any misleading, deceptive, untrue or fraudulent representation on a claim form, bill or statement.

disciplinary_grounds.description: As supervising physician for a physician assistant, failure to adequately direct and supervise the physician assistant.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee as the supervising physician for a physician assistant has failed to adequately direct and supervise the physician assistant in accordance with the physician assistant licensure act or rules and regulations adopted under such act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Assisting suicide in violation of K.S.A. 21-5407.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has assisted suicide in violation of K.S.A. 21-3406, prior to its repeal, or K.S.A. 21-5407, and amendments thereto

disciplinary_grounds.description: Giving a worthless check or stopping payment on a debit or credit card for fees or moneys legally due to the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has given a worthless check or stopped payment on a debit or credit card for fees or moneys legally due to the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly or negligently abandoning medical records.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has knowingly or negligently abandoned medical records.

insurance_required.quote: The board, prior to renewal of a license, shall require an active licensee to submit to the board evidence satisfactory to the board that the licensee is maintaining a policy of professional liability insurance as required by K.S.A. 40-3402, and amendments thereto

definition_quote.value: The healing arts include any system, treatment, operation, diagnosis, prescription or practice for the ascertainment, cure, relief, palliation, adjustment or correction of any human disease, ailment, deformity, injury, alteration or enhancement of a condition or appearance and includes specifically, but not by way of limitation, the practice of medicine and surgery; the practice of osteopathic medicine and surgery; and the practice of chiropractic.
definition_quote.quote: The healing arts include any system, treatment, operation, diagnosis, prescription or practice for the ascertainment, cure, relief, palliation, adjustment or correction of any human disease, ailment, deformity, injury, alteration or enhancement of a condition or appearance and includes specifically, but not by way of limitation, the practice of medicine and surgery; the practice of osteopathic medicine and surgery; and the practice of chiropractic.

value: performing surgical operations using instruments, procedures, equipment, or mechanical devices
methods_authorized.quote: Persons who prescribe, recommend or furnish medicine or drugs, or perform any surgical operation of whatever nature by the use of any surgical instrument, procedure, equipment or mechanical device for the diagnosis, cure or relief of any wounds, fractures, bodily injury, infirmity, disease, physical or mental illness or psychological disorder, of human beings.

drug_authority.value: Licensed physicians may prescribe and administer drugs; controlled substances subject to restrictions under the Uniform Controlled Substances Act and K.S.A. 65-2837a.
drug_authority.quote: rules and regulations, not inconsistent herewith, for carrying out the provisions of any practice act administered by the board, which rules and regulations shall include standards for the dispensing of drugs by persons licensed to practice medicine and surgery.

license_status_types.quote: There is hereby created a designation of an active license... There is hereby created a designation of exempt license... There is hereby created a designation of inactive license... There is hereby created a designation of federally active license... There is hereby created the designation of reentry active license.

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must pass an examination given by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG) in addition to other standard requirements; for postgraduate permits, must also pass ECFMG examination.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: if the applicant is a foreign medical graduate the applicant shall pass an examination given by the educational commission for foreign medical graduates.

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: Amphetamines and sympathomimetic amines in schedules II, III, or IV may only be prescribed for specific enumerated conditions (narcolepsy, ADHD, depression, obesity, binge eating disorder, etc.); failure to comply constitutes unprofessional conduct.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person licensed to practice medicine and surgery to prescribe, order, dispense, administer, sell, supply or give... any amphetamine or sympathomimetic amine designated in schedule II, III or IV under the uniform controlled substances act, except as provided in this section.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: A physician practicing telemedicine must conduct an appropriate assessment and evaluation of the patient's current condition and document the appropriate medical indication for any prescription issued.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: A physician practicing telemedicine in accordance with this subsection shall conduct an appropriate assessment and evaluation of the patient's current condition and document the appropriate medical indication for any prescription issued.

telemedicine_license_available.quote: a physician holding a license issued by the applicable licensing agency of another state or who otherwise meets the requirements of this section may practice telemedicine to treat patients located in the state of Kansas, if such physician receives a telemedicine waiver issued by the state board of healing arts.

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: This act shall be known and may be cited as the interstate medical licensure compact.

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: The licensee as the supervising physician for a physician assistant has failed to adequately direct and supervise the physician assistant in accordance with the physician assistant licensure act or rules and regulations adopted under such act.

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: The licensee has failed to report to the board any adverse judgment, settlement or award against the licensee resulting from a medical malpractice liability claim related to acts or conduct similar to acts or conduct that would constitute grounds for disciplinary action under this section.

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: A medical care facility shall inform the state board of healing arts whenever the practice privileges of any person licensed to practice the healing arts are terminated, suspended or restricted or whenever such privileges are voluntarily surrendered or limited for reasons relating to such person's professional competence.

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: Upon reasonable suspicion that a person's ability to practice such person's profession with reasonable skill and safety to patients is impaired by reason of physical or mental illness, or condition or use of alcohol, drugs or controlled substances, the board shall have authority to compel the person to submit to a mental or physical examination, substance abuse evaluation or drug screen or any combination thereof
